title: Entrepreneur Sergei Kaminskiy, CEO of Kaminskiy Design and Remodeling Company is Making the Dreams of Homeowners Come Into Reality
htmlContent:
Homeowners are reaching the Kaminskiy Design and Remodeling team for a consultation about their remodeling projects and getting secure solutions. The experienced remodeling team of the company is happily hearing their goals and applying them successfully. The company is famous in San Diego for the best customer handling and communication. They have previously worked on various private and government infrastructure remodeling projects. They are shaping homes and infrastructures with their years of experience in renovation and restoration.

Currently, the company is providing bathroom remodeling, basement remodeling in San Diego, and kitchen remodeling. Its bathroom remodeling projects include bathtub and shower design, bathroom doors, bathroom lights, and handheld showerheads. Kaminskiy Design and Remodeling offers many kitchen remodeling services such as cabinets, countertops, sinks and plumbing, lighting, and electricity.

Sergei Kaminskiy is the owner of Kaminskiy Design and Remodeling. He shared that the company is working directly with customers to guide them through every step of the way. It is also making sure that the projects are addressed successfully from start to end. Sergei Kaminskiy company has received many awards over its long history, including in 2011 when they won San Diego’s “Best Contractor”, “Best Home Remodeler”, and “Best Kitchen and Bath Remodeler”, and “Best Local Design”. Despite being 36 years old, Sergei Kaminskiy is already one of San Diego’s Top home Remodelers and real estate agents. He hopes to bring beauty to properties all the while treating every associate with respect. The company is continually working to help customers see possibilities that a remodeling company can bring to their space.

Keep an eye on Sergei Kaminskiy as he navigates the remodeling business in quest of his passion while bringing his followers for the ride, sharing an inside look along the way.
